description: The DHI MATLAB Toolbox provides tools and examples for reading and analysing DHI model data in MATLAB. It supports DFS time-series and grid formats and network result files from MIKE 1D, MIKE 11 and MIKE urban-water products. Users load simulation files into MATLAB for analysis, visualisation or further processing. Coverage is global and inherited from the input model, with no fixed spatial resolution or period. Toolbox source is publicly available free under BSD-3-Clause; MATLAB remains a separately licensed requirement. A limitation is that the documented toolbox works only on Windows and depends on compatible 64-bit MATLAB, .NET interaction and Microsoft native runtimes. The reviewed release bundles the components needed for DFS access and does not require a full MIKE installation for those operations. It supports examination of hydraulic results, complementing the catalogue's MIKE+ platform (platform-dhi-mike-plus). The README distinguishes older installation arrangements from version 19 onward. No toolbox archive or model result file was downloaded.
